Perhaps I should try pressing KeyE to interact with the notice board (read it) which might be the intended action and could reposition me. Let me try KeyE facing right (toward player) and also try the door.

Actually — new idea: maybe the game's movement is blocked because the PLAYER is adjacent and "in the way" in a way that the engine treats as a wall for me. But up/down/left are also blocked.

Let me try walking to a far tile and watch the exact legs — maybe it moves 1 tile then gets stuck. Earlier "14 legs" suggests it kept trying. 

Let me try a single very short tap and immediately observe position via a fresh observe (not the input report which might be stale).
